verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is a Python library where agents are called via a plain run() method (docs-2, docs-25) or run on durable background queues (docs-10), making headless/CI usage native rather than requiring a UI. It also ships TestModel/FunctionModel for automated testing (docs-30) and Pydantic Evals, a code-first evaluation framework explicitly built for systematically testing AI systems (docs-13, docs-21), both fitting CI automation workflows. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline documentation (e.g., GitHub Actions examples), independent hands-on report of running it in CI.
